correctness.rationale: The exact last-first-arrival Poisson conditioning gives n-1 independent nonzero truncated Poisson vectors and a single deterministic last-coupon contribution. Exact means, covariances, positive variances follow. Conditional multivariate Lindeberg at fixed J has diverging diagonal variance W a_{n,j} and vanishing normalized off-diagonals; the Exp maximum mixes it correctly. Stopped counting martingale isometry bounds observed time minus Poisson time, and direct derivatives control the substitution uniformly near log n. All infinite-domain steps are analytical; the packaged finite identities are consistency checks only.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A theorem can cover more album indices yet be weaker in asymptotic resolution. Neither first-order multidimensional result determines second-order independent Gaussian residuals, the data-based centering, or the exact conditional decay constant. Generic Lindeberg theory is an input, not a prior application settling these claims.
